notes: AUTHORED 2026-09-22 (census B14). ITS OWN SCHEDULE, not a second task inside gold_board_crush.json, because leviathan.silver.dag_catalog gives board_crush and futures_spreads SEPARATE families on purpose (one on-call answer per family, one tightest-ceiling arithmetic per family) and a descriptor carries exactly one family. THE DEFECT IT CLOSES IS TWO DEFECTS. First, the same as B3: a SERVED card bound to a board leg with no descriptor, no jobdef and no schedule, hand-produced once on 2026-08-21 and 32 days stale on 2026-09-22. Second, and WORSE because it hid the first: configs/silver/tables/gold_futures_spreads.yaml declared freshness_sla {cadence: null, max_lag_days: null}, so dag_catalog.effective_sla_lag_days fell through BOTH rungs to the _CADENCE_FALLBACK_LAG_DAYS of 46 and a 32-day-old DAILY table reported GREEN. The cadence is now declared daily/5 -- the same ceiling its sole input silver_futures_eod carries, including that table's ratified weekend grace -- through scripts/silver/gen_registry_from_baseline.py CURATION_OVERRIDES (the registry YAMLs are GENERATED; hand-editing one is undone by the next run), exactly as gold_board_crush has declared it since D-EC DK-13. THE CRON is the sibling's, and for the same reason: 10:00 UTC TUE-SAT is two hours after the databento chain that writes the kc_chi pair's two legs (hard_red_winter_wheat_kcbt / soft_red_winter_wheat_cbot). The white_yellow pair's two JSE legs are written by futures_eod_free at cron(30 22 ? * MON-FRI *), i.e. the PREVIOUS evening, so both pairs are reading the same prior session when this fires. PARTIAL-PAIR POSTURE, deliberately different from the crush's fail-closed: this table is N independent pairs, so a pair whose venue is dark emits nothing FOR THAT PAIR and says so in its ledger while the others publish; the zero-row fence (gold_futures_spreads_task.py:106-109) still refuses to overwrite the published table with an empty frame. NO NEW JOB DEFINITION: leviathan-dev-b3-flat-silver is the worker image this producer needs (rev 44, worker digest 46f55987, 1 vCPU / 4096 MB) and the whole input is 32 objects totalling 1.8 MB compressed across the four slugs (measured 2026-09-22) -- see gold_board_crush.json's notes for the full argument. PUBLISH_MODE latest_only + PROMOTE_MODE post_publish_audit: the producer writes gold/futures_spreads/part-000.parquet directly with put_object and has no --publish-mode flag, so the promote Map renders EMPTY and the gate is an audit of a completed write. BEFORE THE FIRST FIRE mint s3://leviathan-dev-shahem-001/cascade_census/rolling/gold_futures_spreads/census.json -- the gate fails closed on a missing baseline. VERIFICATION: the first 10:00Z TUE-SAT fire SUCCEEDS and a read-only re-read shows max(trade_date) within 5 days of the fire for the kc_chi pair.
